hypothesis: When a fully qualified fresh core entry is partially or fully rejected only by settled-cash admission, persisting the exact unfilled shares in a FIFO order queue and filling them at a later open after ordinary exits release cash, while the original stop-target thesis remains unbreached, should recover missed alpha without leverage or incumbent liquidation.

prediction.confidence_reason: The three frozen windows contain 17/23/16 cash conflicts and 10/18/7 full skips with later OHLCV, so the state machine has enough opportunities; however delayed entry can decay and stringent no-lookahead invalidation may cancel many orders.

calibration.surprise_note: FIFO invariants and cash conservation were clean, but only 12 delayed fills materialized versus the 20-fill floor and the delayed entries reduced aggregate EV/PnL.

causal_components: next-open fill after ordinary cash release
change_summary: Evaluated exact unfilled-share FIFO persistence after cash-only entry rejection, with later-open execution and original price-thesis invalidation; no leverage or incumbent liquidation was permitted.
notes: Aggregate EV 6.2057 to 5.6413; aggregate PnL 130992.36 to 123188.19; delayed fills=12.
rejection_reason: Pre-registered Gate-4 checks failed: aggregate_ev_above_10pct_bar, aggregate_pnl_above_baseline, at_least_two_windows_improve_both_ev_and_pnl, no_window_ev_regresses_more_than_5pct, signal_generation_and_survival_unchanged, at_least_20_delayed_fills

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The queue produced only twelve delayed fills. Old-thin improved, but late-strong and mid-weak both lost EV and PnL; aggregate EV fell 0.5644 and aggregate PnL fell 7804.17. All FIFO, thesis, cash-conservation, and concentration checks were clean, so the economic failure is stale-order displacement rather than a measurement or bookkeeping defect.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune queue age, FIFO priority, cash-shortfall size, or price-thesis thresholds on these same outcomes.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A new data source, genuinely different gate shape, or materially more settled forward cash-conflict decisions is required.

reproduction_note: The measured artifacts are retained, but the rejected backtester integration was rolled back after Gate 4. Exact rerun requires deliberately reconstructing that historical integration from the retained helper and artifacts; the runner alone fails safely.
